hints.title: Zero Inclusion Cost
hints.text: Every '0' in the binary string increases the length without increasing the numeric value when placed as leading zeros.

hints.title: Right to Left Greed
hints.text: Include all '0's. Then, scanning from right to left, include '1's at power 2^pos as long as the value does not exceed k.

hints.title: Overflow Prevention
hints.text: When 2^pos exceeds k, no further '1's can be included.

hints.title: Greedy Binary Subsequence Implementation

complexity.notes: Single pass from right to left with constant bit checking.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: General DP takes O(n * log k); greedy right-to-left takes O(n).
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate proves that all zeros should be kept and ones greedily selected from right to left.
